query: What is the maximum annual printing credit?
answer_text: Student printing is free (but not unlimited) and is capped at £20 per year starting from 1 September.

query: How do I connect to eduroam on campus?
answer_text: You only need to connect to eduroam once. Subsequently, you'll be able to connect on campus without authentication.

query: What is the excess for emergency medical costs?
answer_text: An excess of £150 will apply to any emergency medical expenses, before a claim will be considered.

query: How do I apply for a coursework extension?
answer_text: Extensions must be requested by no later than 12:00 noon on the day of your deadline. You do not need to provide evidence to request an extension.

query: Who do I contact for disability support?
answer_text: You can refer yourself via the MyBradford – Request for Support form. You can also email disabilities@bradford.ac.uk if you would like to discuss things further.

query: How do I install the SafeZone app?
answer_text: The SafeZone app can be downloaded to either iPhone or Android.

query: Who can I call in a mental health crisis?
answer_text: Call Bradford NHS First Response on 0800 952 1181 in a mental health crisis.

query: What are the steps to suspend my studies?
answer_text: Log onto e:Vision, Click on the Change of Circumstances link at the bottom, In the drop down menu, select Suspend study, Follow the instructions on e:Vision to complete the process.

query: How do I change my University password?
answer_text: Sign in to https://myaccount.microsoft.com and select Change Password.

query: How can I refer myself to Disability Service?
answer_text: You can refer yourself via the MyBradford – Request for Support form. You can also email disabilities@bradford.ac.uk if you would like to discuss things further.

query: What is the deadline to request Extenuating Circumstances?
answer_text: Extenuating Circumstances must be requested no later than 7 days after the date of your assessment/deadline.
Academic Misconduct = Cheating – if students present work which they have not produced as though it is their own, this is cheating and will be investigated as academic misconduct.

query: How do I submit a formal complaint?
answer_text: Your complaint should be submitted to the Student Casework Manager via complaintsandappeals@bradford.ac.uk in writing, detailing the grounds for the complaint and supporting evidence.

query: How do I book a room for group study?
answer_text: Resource Booker allows you to view and select an available location appropriate to your requirements and create a booking at any time.
